powerBanks.name: Bank B1
powerBanks.source: printed on unit front panel (user photo): "MAX CURRENT PER OUTLET 10 AMPS, MAX CURRENT PER OUTLET BANK (B1 OR B2) 16 AMPS" and "OUTPUT: 220-240 VAC 50/60HZ, 32A". 230 V is the nominal value within the printed 220–240 V range. Each bank has its own breaker (B1 top row outlets 1–8, B2 bottom row outlets 9–16).

powerBanks.name: Bank B2
powerBanks.source: printed on unit front panel (user photo): "MAX CURRENT PER OUTLET 10 AMPS, MAX CURRENT PER OUTLET BANK (B1 OR B2) 16 AMPS" and "OUTPUT: 220-240 VAC 50/60HZ, 32A". 230 V is the nominal value within the printed 220–240 V range. Each bank has its own breaker (B1 top row outlets 1–8, B2 bottom row outlets 9–16).

source: Outlets-front orientation: the mounting brackets sit forward of the body so plugged IEC plugs stay behind the rack front. User measured ear plane to rear of body as 190–195 mm; modelled as 192 mm (±3 mm). With the 114.3 mm body this places the outlet face 77.7 mm behind the ear plane (derived, ±3 mm). Parts-only geometry: one body solid from z = 77.7 to 192 mm and two bracket side plates spanning the ear plane to the body front, kept inside the body-width envelope; their 2 mm thickness and full-height rectangular profile are PROVISIONAL envelopes (the photographed brackets are angled plates). Body 444.5 × 88.9 × 114.3 mm and 4.5 kg from Schneider Electric product page https://shop.se.com/pro/ca/en/product/rack-pdu-switched-2u-32a-230v-16-c13/ (2U, W445 × D114 × H89 mm rounded, 4.5 kg, 16 × IEC C13, IEC 60309 32 A input); retailer listings give 444.5 × 114.3 × 88.9 mm and 4.5 kg (9.92 lb). User measured the body width as about 450 mm, consistent with 444.5 mm. Per-outlet and per-bank current limits and the 220–240 V, 32 A output rating are printed on the unit front panel (user photo); see powerBanks. PROVISIONAL: ear thickness unknown (2 mm illustrative preview), ear screw holes at 22.225/66.675 mm (middle hole of each U) are a placeholder pending confirmation, and every port centre is a placeholder (see each port). PDU power draw is not published here and is not set. No rail kit or other manufacturer compatibility is inferred.

A user photograph shows the cord leaving near the rear corner of the left end (left as seen facing the outlets); whether it leaves the rear face or the end face is not confirmed, and the exit centre is a placeholder.
